title: Headset-VR Configuration and Profile Field Evidence
licence: Creator-controlled videos, captions and written posts; UEVR profiles, CVars, scripts and other attachments may be community-authored and retain their own terms. Store metadata, attribution, timestamps and independently written configuration notes only unless exact reuse permission is established.
evidence_role: Operational configuration evidence for converting flat games to VR: UEVR profile selection, 6DoF setup, CVars, controller attachment, menu interaction, camera mode, runtime constraints, install order, compatibility and playability.

known_boundaries: Headset-VR is not the normative authority for UEVR internals; prefer UEVR source and documentation for implementation claims.
A working creator profile is evidence for a particular game build, executable, runtime, headset and configuration, not universal compatibility.
Community-authored profiles must retain the original author and source; do not silently attribute every attachment to Headset-VR.
Do not rehost Patreon attachments or creator video content unless provenance and reuse rights are explicit.
Quest 3 and Meta Air Link acceptance remain separate Battle Bridge evidence even when a post carries a Quest 3 tag.
promotion_rule: Extract reproducible configuration recipes with exact game/executable/profile/runtime provenance, distinguish creator and community authorship, verify implementation claims against canonical tools, and require local headset proof before acceptance.
